title: Morphogenesis E02b portable inference package
subtitle: Lite NCA checkpoints, canonical E02b census and verifier (no training weights)
description: Portable inference package for the closed E02b morphospace census of Project Morphogenesis. Contains 12 lite NCA checkpoints (model_state_dict + scalars + metadata, ~0.15 MB each instead of 514.5 MB full files with the training state pool), the canonical census.json (832 rollouts), frozen class centroids, the exact inference sources, and verify_portable.py. Smoke mode reproduces 2 learned models plus the untrained architecture over 16 seeds x 2000 steps and compares classes against the census. No training, no gradient, no new scientific claims: the package reproduces an already closed result. struct_1 is an architectural confound, struct_2 is the learned candidate; results do not imply life, consciousness or intelligence. Full sha256 of the original checkpoints is recorded in portable_manifest.json. License MIT, see LICENSE.
